description: The program has no stated purpose or goals; champions don't know what it is meant to achieve.
An informal, unwritten idea of the program's purpose exists but hasn't been communicated or agreed upon.
A basic vision statement exists and has been shared with champions, but it isn't tied to concrete goals or reviewed regularly.
A documented vision with clear goals guides program decisions and is periodically revisited with input from champions.
The vision is well-documented, actively used to prioritize program activities, communicated across the organization, and evolves based on regular feedback from champions and leadership.
